# MuregiScore Technologies

> MuregiScore Technologies is a multi-disciplinary technology solutions umbrella company based in Nairobi, Kenya, founded and led by Victor Muregi. It engineers mission-critical business software, operational automation, mobile payment rails, and industry-specific platforms across Sub-Saharan Africa.

## Who is Victor Muregi?

Victor Muregi is a full-stack software engineer and founder of MuregiScore Technologies based in Nairobi, Kenya. He specializes in multi-tenant SaaS systems, M-Pesa (Safaricom Daraja) payment integrations, education technology (CBC & 8-4-4), and operational software for Kenyan SMEs and schools.

Key focus areas:
- Multi-tenant architecture with strict tenant isolation
- Role-based access control (RBAC)
- Asynchronous background jobs (BullMQ + Redis)
- Safaricom Daraja STK Push, C2B webhooks, and reconciliation
- Constraint solvers (school timetabling)

## Engineering Divisions

- **Division 01: Business Software**: Multi-tenant CRM platforms, client lifecycle management, sales deal pipelines, and automated business workflows engineered for African SMEs.
  - Architecture Model: https://github.com/Muregis/Core-Crm-model
- **Division 02: Education Technology**: End-to-end institutional administration supporting CBC and 8-4-4 structures.
  - Live: https://educore.muregiscore.me · https://ratiba.muregiscore.me
  - Repositories: https://github.com/Muregis/educore-school-management-system · https://github.com/Muregis/Educore-Ratiba
- **Division 03: Payments & Integrations**: Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa STK Push, C2B webhooks, Paybill & Till reconciliation, bulk B2C disbursements.
- **Division 04: Industry-Specific Systems**: Livestock digital passports, pedigree tracking, milk yield analytics.
  - Live: https://livestock-management-app.vercel.app
- **Division 05: Websites & Digital Platforms**: High-performance commercial portals.
- **Division 06: Bespoke Engineering**: Custom schemas, constraint optimization, high-availability systems.

## Key Technical Specifications

- Multi-tenant data isolation, BullMQ/Redis queues
- Safaricom Daraja REST APIs (STK Push, C2B, B2C), Paystack
- Timetable generation using modified FET constraint logic for Kenyan CBC
- Stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Tailwind CSS
